# Answer position is exactly/maximally Sheet1!A1:B10.
start_row, end_row = 1, 10
col_a, col_b = 1, 2

def is_number(v):
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and not (isinstance(v, float) and math.isnan(v))

# Compute Excel-like AVERAGE(B1:B10): numeric cells only.
b_numbers = []

        if is_number(v):
            cumulative += float(v)
        if cumulative >= avg_b:
            threshold_row = r
            break

# Clear existing fills in A1:A10 so the computed highlight is exact.
